hints: Compute left = 2*i+1 and right = 2*i+2 first, then guard every access with 'index < n'. A child that does not exist must never be compared.
Track the winner in a variable called largest, starting at i. Compare against left, then against largest again for right - not against a[i] twice, or you can miss the right child.
After swapping, recurse on largest, not on i. The displaced value moved down to index largest and may still violate the property there.
